title: loeseneriella africana var. togoensis

This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits, including the treatment of fever, pain, and respiratory issues, as well as its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Loeseneriella africana var. togoensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, that exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
